newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BLACKBURN PLAY DOWN REPORTS OF CITKO DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLACKBURN PLAY DOWN REPORTS OF CITKO DEAL.

text.p: English premier league side Blackburn have confirmed an interest in Polish striker Marek Citko but insist they are nowhere near reaching a deal to bring him to Ewood Park..

"We have made a request that the player spends a couple of days training with us sometime in the next few weeks, but that is all there is to it at this stage," Blackburn caretaker manager Tony Parkes said on Monday.

He denied a report in a British Sunday newspaper which claimed Citko would travel to Blackburn this week for talks over personal terms and to undergo a medical before signing a deal worth four million pounds ($6.7 million).
Blackburn have been short of fire-power in attack since selling Alan Shearer to Newcastle in July and have spent most of the season in the relegation zone.
"We are always on the look out (for players) and if something that interests us comes along we will make a move," Parkes said.
